{{Quote|Who are the Sulfur Lake Pirates?''"<br />"''Probably the most bloodthirsty, least-intelligent pirates on Lok.|A spacer and [[Vana Sage]]|<ref name="SWG:MVS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Meet Vana Sage|Lok}}</ref>}}
The '''Sulfur Lake Pirates''' were a gang of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] active during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. On the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lok/Legends|Lok]], they were the main competitors of [[Nym/Legends|Nym's]] [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]].

==Description==
{{Quote|The Sulfur Lake Pirates aren't the brightest pirate band on Lok. First, they named themselves after the lake where they have their 'hidden' lair. When they realized that every other group on Lok knew where they were holed up, the Sulfur crew hired me to set up some defenses. We eventually had a... falling out.|[[Choster]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SwC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Speak with Choster|Lok}}</ref>}}
[[File:Sulfur_Lake_Pirate_Hideout.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The [[Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout]]]]
The Sulfur Lake Pirates were known as the most bloodthirsty and least-intelligent pirates on Lok. They had a strong rivalry with the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] and contested the position of the old [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] as the absolute ruler of Lok and the entire [[Karthakk system|star system]]. Although they were clearly weaker than the Revenants, they aspired to overthrow Nym someday. Nevertheless, Nym had always tried to minimize the hostility between the two groups as much as possible in order to avoid a bloody and useless war on Lok.<ref name="SWG:MVS" />

Despite their brutality, the Sulfur Lake Pirates were regarded with disdain by other criminals who considered them stupid since the early days of the existence of the group. The pirates named themselves the Sulfur Lake Pirates because they built their [[Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout|secret hideout]] near the large [[Sulfur Lake]] on Lok. Hence, they unwittingly revealed to their rivals and enemies the location of their hidden lair. They therefore counterbalanced this mistake by establishing a sophisticated security system for their base. The pirates hired the [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Choster]] to set up the defenses, but they attempted to assassinate him when the job was done.<ref name="SWG:SwC" />

==History==
{{Quote|Like all the other pirate bands, they are constantly trying to dethrone Nym as Lok's reigning pirate king. They hate Nym for taking control of all the nearby hyperspace routes and claim that he's working with the Imperials. The gravel maggots have been looking for an excuse to go to war with us for years...|Vana Sage, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MVS" />}}
The Sulfur Lake Pirates were active on the planet since as late as the early days of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and had always been in conflict with Nym's Revenants.<ref name="SWG:MVS" /> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the pirates kept a large [[pharple]], a flightless [[Bird/Legends|bird]] species from Lok, named [[Nym's Girlfriend]] to insult the leader of the Lok Revenants.<ref name="SWG:EB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Embarrassing Breakup|Lok}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] crashed-landed near the hideout of the Sulfur Lake Pirates after it took off from a secret [[Imperial Mine (Lok)|Imperial mining installation]] on Lok. Indeed, the Sulfur Lake Pirates were the first to discover the crashed starship and they salvaged anything valuable from its cargo. The crash was soon discovered by Nym and his head of security, [[Vana Sage]]. As the Revenants had never been able to infiltrate the Imperial mine, Vana Sage realized that the cargo could contain more information about the Imperial mining installation than everything they learnt before.<ref name="SWG:MVS" /> Sage thus tasked a group of spacers who had recently joined the Lok Revenants with retrieving Imperial data from the cargo. The spacers and one of Nym's [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] then raided the Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout. Thanks to the help of Choster, the engineer who was eager to take his revenge on the Sulfur Lake Pirates, the spacers and the slicer bypassed the pirate security system and infiltrated the base.<ref name="SWG:RtDD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Retrieve the Droid Disk|Lok}}</ref> During the assault, the spacers killed the pharple known as Nym's Girlfriend<ref name="SWG:EB" /> as well as the [[Bridge Troll]], a large [[gurk]] trained by the Sulfur Lake Pirates to defend their hideout.<ref name="SWG:KtBT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Kill the Bridge Troll|Lok}}</ref> They also placed [[Listening device/Legends|surveillance devices]] all around the base<ref name="SWG:PtSD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Place the Surveillance Devices|Lok}}</ref> and rescued a member of the Lok Revenants who had been captured.<ref name="SWG:RtLR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Rescue the Lok Revenant|Lok}}</ref> Finally, after having killed numerous pirates, the spacers collected the [[memory module]] of an Imperial [[Droid/Legends|droid]].<ref name="SWG:RtDD" />

After the attack on the Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout, the tensions between the Lok Revenants and the Sulfur Lake Pirates turned to open war. Finally, after some time, Nym grew weary of the situation and proposed a truce to the Sulfur Lake Pirates. The pirates accepted but only because they saw an opportunity to take their revenge. A meeting was arranged in [[Kimogila Town]], an abandoned city in the deserts of Lok. The group of Sulfur Lake "negotiators" was led by [[Cale Serasai]], while the Lok Revenants were represented by the spacers responsible for the assault on the Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout. Yet not long before the meeting took place, the pirates captured [[Sheeli]], the sister of the engineer Choster. When the meeting began, Serasai indeed did not try to negotiate the peace but instead revealed that they had captured Sheeli. He threatened to kill her and ordered the Lok Revenants to hand over Choster. The spacer transmitted the request to Nym, but the Revenants leader refused to betray Choster. Many Sulfur Lake Pirates hidden in the ruins of Kimogila Town then suddenly attacked Nym's ambassadors. However, although the spacers were outnumbered, they successfully defended themselves and killed all the pirates. The only survivor was Cale Serasai, who begged to be spared and agreed to release Sheeli in exchange for his life.<ref name="SWG:NP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Negotiate Peace|Lok}}</ref>

[[File:SWG_quest_Envoy.png|thumb|right|250px|The Sulfur Lake Pirates attack [[Nym's Base|Nym's palace]].]]

After this new humiliation, Nym thought that the Sulfur Lake Pirates would try to strike back soon. Indeed, the pirates were already preparing their next move. A short time after the firefight in Kimogila Town, Nym planned to receive an envoy of politicians from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[Nym's Base|his palace]] on Lok. But the pirates hijacked the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] of the Tatooinan and landed it in the courtyard of Nym's palace. As Nym and the other leaders of the Lok Revenants&mdash;[[Kole]], Vana Sage and [[Jinkins]]&mdash;arrived to greet the envoys, the pirates unexpectedly emerged from the shuttle and attacked the Revenants. A battle therefore erupted in the palace. Finally, with the assistance of the loyal spacers, the Revenants eliminated every Sulfur Lake Pirate. Nym and all his lieutenants survived the attack.<ref name="SWG:E">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Envoy|Lok}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Sulfur Lake Pirates appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RtDD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Sulfur Lake Pirates were added to the game as part of the so-called "[[W:c:swg:Nym's Theme Park|Nym's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:NTP" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 3 Notes: 8 October 03|Publish 3]]" on [[October 8]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 3: The Warren">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60890|text=Publish 3: The Warren}}</ref> This questline was later revamped with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants]]," on [[March 23]], [[2010]].<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref>
